name: Saiin Haramase Keyword "...An, Sonna koto Iwaretara, mou Watashi... Watashi..."
original_name: 催淫孕ませキーワード「…あぁん、そんなコト言われたら、もう私…わたし…」
source:
Kouhei works for a cleanup company. One day, when he cleans an apartment room, he finds a notebook. He opens it and it says, "This magic word changes any girls into nymphos." He puts the notebook into his pocket.... The next morning, he whispers the magic word into Yumi's ear, his sister-in-law. She gets sexually aroused soon and presses herself against him. He now gets the magic word....

translation:
公平在一家清洁公司工作。一天，他清理某间公寓时发现一个笔记本。打开后，上面写着：“这句咒语能把任何姑娘变成淫荡女人。”他把笔记本放进口袋…第二天早上，他在嫂子由美耳边低声念出咒语。她很快产生性兴奋，主动贴到他身上。如今，他得到了这句魔法关键词…
